requirements.display_name: W16W 12 V 16 W backup light bulb

actions.title: Turn the lights off and let the bulb cool
actions.instruction: Turn the lights off and wait until the backup-light bulb is cool before beginning replacement. Confirm the replacement bulb is W16W, 12 V 16 W.
actions.warning_text: Illuminated bulbs can become hot enough to cause burns. Use only the specified wattage.

actions.title: Remove the rear-gate light cover
actions.instruction: Apply the flat-head screwdriver to the light cover as shown in the owner manual and carefully pry the cover off the rear-gate trim.

actions.title: Remove the backup-light socket
actions.instruction: Turn the bulb socket counterclockwise and remove it from the lamp opening.

actions.title: Replace the backup-light bulb
actions.instruction: Pull the old bulb straight out of the socket and install the new W16W 12 V 16 W bulb. Avoid touching the glass with bare hands.
actions.warning_text: Do not touch the glass portion of the replacement bulb with bare hands.

actions.title: Install the backup-light socket
actions.instruction: Install the bulb socket by turning it clockwise, then route the wire as shown in the owner manual.

actions.title: Restore the rear-gate light cover
actions.instruction: Install the light cover back onto the rear-gate trim and make sure it is seated in place.
